__**If you are missing the Patreon status/roles try the following steps:**__

1. Go to https://www.patreon.com/settings/apps/discord ensuring that your Discord ID is correct and you are connected to OwO bot support. (**1st image**)
2. Go to https://www.patreon.com/settings/basics and change your display name, change it to anything (make sure to click save after changing it) and then change it back. **This is your patreon display name, not discord** (**2nd image**)
3. Success! Write `owo Patreon` in our server 🎉 You should now have the roles and status! 

If `owo Patreon` still doesn’t show that you’re a member, you have the option to DM Scoot regarding it. 
**Do not DM Scoot if you are just missing the roles. The Patreon roles are not essential for receiving the benefits.**

You can use weapon shards <:Azws:837538614409691166> to reroll your weapons (excluding <:104rune:594613521665490974> and boss weapons). Every reroll costs 100 <:Azws:837538614409691166>.

__Commands:__
> Reroll Passive: `owo w rr (weaponID) p`

> Reroll Stats: `owo w rr (weaponID) s`

You can choose from 3 options in the reroll message:
✅ __Confirm__ - This will save the changes made to stats/passives that are shown in the lower half of the reroll message.
🔁 __Reroll__ - This will consume another 100 <:Azws:837538614409691166> and reroll 1 more time.
<:8Across_box:808212600331829259> __Cancel__ - This will cancel the reroll, and you will get your weapon back with no changes made.

Note: If you have less than 100 <:Azws:837538614409691166> and click on 🔁 reroll, OwO will automatically cancel the reroll and you will get back your weapon with no changes made.

If you are unsure about what to reroll or still confused about how it works, feel free to ask in <#536642004021411843> or <#1134192784190996631>!

**<:Azws:837538614409691166> Weapon shards are a currency that can be earned from quests, checklist, boss fights, and dismantling weapons.**

With weapon shards, you can:
• <:crate:621848189133258756> **Buy crates** (`owo buy 100`)
This is not recommended, but it is an option in case you really need crates.
• <:101sword:594613521271095299> **Buy weapons ** (`owo shop w`)
The weapon shop sometimes has good weapons, although some may be costly. 
• 🔁 **Reroll a weapon** (`owo w rr {weapon ID} p/s`)
You can change the stats or passive of a weapon you already own.

<#536642004021411843> can assist with choosing weapons to buy or reroll.

To appeal a ban for **macros/botting**, make sure a staff member is in chat and ask if they are able to review your appeal.
You will need to have **uncropped screenshots** of all the following:
- Any warnings (0/5), (1/5), (2/5) - (5/5)
- The banned message.
- The captcha or link. 
- Any attempts you made of trying to click the link or type the captcha code.
Do NOT post any screenshots until a staff member asks you to. Staff members have `{ADMIN}`, `{MANAGER}` or `{HELPER}` in their name as well as a checkmark role icon.

لتقديم طلب لرفع الحظر ، نحتاج إلى رؤية لقطات شاشة (صور) غير مقصوصة من:
1) أي تحذيرات (0/5) ، (1/5) ، (2/5) - (5/5)
2) رسالة الحظر.
3) كلمة التحقق أو الرابط.
4) أي محاولات قمت بها لمحاولة النقر على الرابط أو كتابة رمز captcha.
5) أرسل لقطات الشاشة فقط عند تواجد أحد من فريق العمل.
فريق العمل يكون في اسمهم `{ADMIN}` أو `{MANAGER}` أو `{HELPER}`.
قد يطرح عليك فريق العمل بعض الأسئلة لاستكمال الطلب.

Pour faire appel d'un ban, vous devez fournir les captures d'écran non retouchées/rognées de:
1) Tous les avertissement (0/5), (1/5), (2/5)...(5/5)
2) Le message de ban
3) Le mot de passe(captcha) ou le lien
4) Toutes les tentatives que vous avez faites en essayant de cliquer sur le lien ou d'envoyer le code captcha.
5) Envoyez les captures d'écran lorsqu'un membre du staff est disponible. Il pourra vous poser des questions pour compléter votre appel, si besoin est

- Semua peringatanmu (0/5), (1/5), (2/5) - (5/5)
- Pesan ban.
- Captcha atau link. 
- Setiap percobaan yang kamu lakukan untuk menekan link atau mengetik kode captcha.
JANGAN kirim screenshot apapun sampai anggota staff memintanya. Anggota staff memiliki `{ADMIN}`, `{MANAGER}` or `{HELPER}` pada nama mereka beserta ikon role berbentuk tanda centang.

__If your vote isn't working here are some tips:__

- make sure you're on the right account
- have your dms on so owo can dm you your rewards
- say "owo vote" again if you still haven't received your rewards
- go onto the voting website on your browser and clear the cache
- try voting in private/incognito browser
- go to the voting website homepage and search for owo bot instead of using the link

*if nothing above works, then most likely the problem is with website itself 
in that case please try voting after a while or contact top.gg support via their support server.

**__Goal:__ Score 21 or get a score closest to 21 without exceeding it.**
> React with 👊 to add to your score. 
> React with 🛑 to end your turn. The dealer will go next. 
> If you see a `*` next to your score, it means you have an ace that can play as a 1 or 11 depending on how close or far you are to winning. 
> 🏆 If you meet the goal, you win. Good luck! 
*If the game goes inactive or isn’t working, write `owo bj` again to continue the game.*

The `shards` command shows the active shards available and how long they've been up. 
A **shard** is essentially a server of the bot for discord servers. 
If you visualize it like a tree, the trunk is the bot itself. the larger branches are the clusters, the twigs are shards, and each leaf is a server. 
It all leads back to the trunk of the tree but it's split off from other areas at the ends
so while some might be active at the time, not all are

**FAQ** 
*What are collectibles?*
Patreon commands are made by Patreon Supporters, subscribed to the Legendary tier. They have no affect/impact on the main OwO game. (No benefits) 

*How to obtain collectibles?*
You can only get them from people who **already have them.** You give 1 item and the user will receive 2. (except for when receiving **__cake__**, which might give 1-3 at random).

*But how did the first person get one?*
The user who paid for the command has unlimited of their item. When they give to other users, it multiplies that way.

**How do I turn off/on Level Up messages?**
> `owo level disable` for off. For on `owo level enable`
> [not to be confused with `owo disable level` which just disables the command]

**How do I limit OwO Bot to just one chat?**
> 1. Disable all commands in the chats you don't want OwO Bot to be used in (via `owo disable all`)
\- or -
> 2. Change the permissions for the bot in the channels you don't want it used in to have it be unable to read messages in that chat.
> [*please make sure it is specifically unable to **read** messages and **not** unable to **send** messages as any possible verification warnings could be lost*]

It’s a __lottery__, OwO picks the winner at random. Betting more does raise your winning chances, but there are still thousands of others OwO can pick. It is very possible for the winner to have the same chances as you or even a lower chance. It’s all just luck in the end!

Whenever you open a crate, you have a chance to receive higher weapon "wear" values. The better the wear, the higher the bonus.
- Pristine - 1% chance, adds +5% quality to the weapon
- Fine - 5% chance, adds +3% quality to the weapon
- Decent - 10% chance, adds +1% quality to the weapon
- Worn - Default, no benefits
- Unknown - Any weapon created before this update, no benefits

Some things to note about the wear values:
- Yes, it would be possible to get an average quality of 105% Fabled weapon
- Every time you make a reroll change (accept the outcome), the wear of the weapon will degrade by one stage. This means that the wear does not decrease if you cancel the reroll.
Example: if you reroll a Pristine Shield, it will become a Fine Shield (only if you press accept)

Weapons will have a 10% chance to come with a "Takedown Tracker" or TT for short. It's basically the same things as CSGO's stat tracker. If an animal has this weapon equipped and kills an opponent, it will receive +1 to it's TT. This is purely for aesthetics and will not give any bonuses. Rerolling the weapon will not lose it's TT, it is permanent.

Leaderboards that can show the highest kills with weapons (weapons with TT only show) 
- owo top weapon global - Displays the weapon with most kills
- owo my weapon global - Displays your current weapon with the highest kills
There is also a leaderboard for each weapon! The format is w{weaponId}. Weapon IDs can be found by typing owo inv.
- owo top w102 global - Displays a leaderboard of Heal Staffs with the highest kills
- owo my w115 global - Displays your current Glacial Axe with the highest kills.
